name: location
assumes: the disk cache is on (see enabled)
home=none covers no HOME and no passwd entry (os.homedir throws or returns a relative path)

writable means the directory exists or can be created and can be written; for the xdg, home and tmp locations it also means a real directory owned by this user that no other user can write (nodeCacheDirHost.writable with isPrivate), so one another user made is unwritable here
the tmp location is os.tmpdir()/universal-netlist-<uid>, one per user
